query: INSERT INTO social_media_platform_schedule (streamer_login, twitch_user_id, platform, auto_post, posts_per_week, max_posts_per_day, post_times, updated_at, updated_by) SELECT twitch_login, twitch_user_id, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6::text::jsonb, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, $7 FROM twitch_streamers WHERE twitch_user_id = $1 ON CONFLICT (twitch_user_id, platform) WHERE twitch_user_id IS NOT NULL DO UPDATE SET streamer_login = EXCLUDED.streamer_login, auto_post = EXCLUDED.auto_post, posts_per_week = EXCLUDED.posts_per_week, max_posts_per_day = EXCLUDED.max_posts_per_day, post_times = EXCLUDED.post_times, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by
